content_sections.text: Assistant and Mentor cum Typist: Bachelor degree in Science, Arts, Commerce, Engineering, Medicine or any other branch from a recognized university AND Computer on Office Automation course conducted by Directorate of Technical Education or computer related Diploma / Degree from a recognized university. Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk: 10th standard exam or equivalent pass. Office Assistant: 8th standard exam or equivalent pass.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Tirunelveli Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.tirunelveli.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 13-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Child Protection Unit Tirunelveli (DCPU Tirunelveli) for filling various temporary positions.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in DCPU Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Assistant and Mentor cum Typist, Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk, and Office Assistant under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies released?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across different posts in the District Child Protection Unit Tirunelveli.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must download the form, fill it, and send it by post or in person.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form is 13-10-2026. Late applications will be rejected.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 42 years as on 01.09.2026 for all posts listed in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required for Office Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates who have passed the 8th standard or an equivalent examination are eligible to apply for the Office Assistant post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Assistant and Mentor cum Typist post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant and Mentor cum Typist post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send the completed application form?
faq.answer: You should send the filled application form to the District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, District Collectorate, Kokkirakulam, Tirunelveli.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form from the official website of Tirunelveli district at www.tirunelveli.nic.in.
